name: Particle Based Simulation Techniques
description: Introduction to particle-based simulations in chemical engineering. Fundamentals of molecular dynamics simulations (MD). Coarse-graining, soft matter systems, and hydrodynamic interactions. Mesoscale methods with hydrodynamic interactions. Dissipative particle dynamics. Discrete element method (DEM) for granular systems. Fluid-particle coupling (CFD-DEM). Monte Carlo methods for statistical mechanics, smoothed particle hydrodynamics (SPH). Emerging techniques for fluid-particle simulations. Case study as an application to particle-based simulations in process and chemical industries.
